title: DOT-07: GAO-26-107648 Recommendation 1 implementation artifact and milestone record — Phase 65 Aviation review
summary: Phase 65 reviews this primary record as part of the Aviation reporting pack. GAO-26-107648 Recommendation 1 remains Open. Its normalized follow-through state is Promised; the record separates the named artifact, visibility, milestone, GAO review state, and remaining gap.
key_findings: Current GAO status: Open; status period: June 2026.

Response artifact: BVLOS rulemaking, industry standards, phased deployment, and long-term research initiatives. FAA described near- and long-term actions; its public drone strategy provides context but GAO has not recorded implementation of the recommendation.
Artifact availability: Public official strategy located; other actions remain described on the GAO page.
Named milestone: March 30, 2027; milestone state: Future monitor.
GAO review state: Initial actions not yet complete.
Remaining gap: Implemented actions with clear roles, estimated costs, and technical milestones for communication and detect-and-avoid capability.

Continuation rule: Recheck at material rule, standards, or March 2027 milestone changes. Preserve DOT-07 as the parent crosswalk; do not translate an artifact, promise, submission, or GAO review into implementation, closure, or operating outcome.
why_it_matters: Which records separate plans, rules, trials, and workforce processes from certification, accepted service, recurring operations, and comparable reliability? This record supplies one bounded part of that evidence chain; it is not a substitute for the pack's downstream records. Recommendation-specific follow-through makes it possible to distinguish a promise, an available artifact, a submission, GAO review, partial addressing, implementation, closure, and later operating outcomes.
ftfn_relevance: Preserves DOT-07 as the parent crosswalk.
Records public artifact availability without treating availability as sufficiency or implementation.
Keeps named dates as monitors that do not pause the active content queue.
evidence_limits: Inclusion in a Phase 65 reporting pack does not advance a Phase 64 matrix cell or establish an operating outcome.
A promised milestone is a monitor, not implementation evidence.
An agency artifact or submission is not implementation unless its scope satisfies the recommendation and the official record supports that conclusion.
Open – Partially Addressed is an official recommendation status, not the Phase 56F Partially Closed entity evidence state.
Recommendation closure would not by itself establish operating performance, readiness, safety, savings, value, or causation.
